topic: Signal blocks phone AI assistants (Siri, Gemini) from reading chats via screenshots
caption:
Signal is now blocking your phone's AI assistant from reading your private chats.

Built-in assistants like Siri and Gemini can see what's on your screen. So Signal is fighting back: on Android it switches on Screen security when it detects an AI trying to read the screen, and on iPhone there's a new "Block Siri AI" setting.

Signal admits it's not perfect. It can't reliably block screenshots on Mac, and AI agents could still reach app data in sneakier ways.

You can turn it off, but Signal warns that could expose your messages and your contacts' messages to these AI agents.

Would you keep this on, or let your AI see your chats? 👇
